newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs seen edging towards 128.03.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs seen edging towards 128.03.

text.p: June BTP futures on LIFFE may have lost their chance of a rebound in the short term after slipping through 128.75 on Thursday, technical analysts said on Friday.
They had resurfaced above that level by 0735 GMT on Friday, standing eight basis points higher at 128.80.
But Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London, said: "To change the whole thing round you certainly need to be at least back above 129.09 which was a selling level yesterday."
She put the next down target at 128.03, around a 61.8 percent retracement of the rally from 125.80 to 131.40.
